005package org.wpilib.command3;
006
007import java.util.List;
008import java.util.function.Consumer;
009import org.wpilib.command3.Scheduler.ScheduleResult;
010import org.wpilib.system.RobotController;
011
012/**
013 * An event that occurs during scheduler processing. This can range from {@link Scheduled a command
014 * being scheduled} by a trigger or manual call to {@link Scheduler#schedule(Command)} to {@link
015 * Interrupted a command being interrupted by another}. Event listeners can be registered with a
016 * scheduler via {@link Scheduler#addEventListener(Consumer)}. All events have a timestamp to
017 * indicate when the event occurred.
018 */
019public sealed interface SchedulerEvent {
020  /**
021   * The timestamp for when the event occurred. Measured in nanoseconds since some arbitrary start
022   * time.
023   *
024   * @return The event timestamp.
025   * @see RobotController#getTime()
026   */
027  long timestampNanos();
028
029  /**
030   * An event marking when a command is scheduled in {@link Scheduler#schedule(Command)}.
031   *
032   * @param command The command that was scheduled
033   * @param timestampNanos When the command was scheduled
034   */
035  record Scheduled(Command command, long timestampNanos) implements SchedulerEvent {}
036
037  /**
038   * An event marking when a command starts running.
039   *
040   * @param command The command that started
041   * @param timestampNanos When the command started
042   */
043  record Mounted(Command command, long timestampNanos) implements SchedulerEvent {}
044
045  /**
046   * An event marking when a command yielded control with {@link Coroutine#yield()}.
047   *
048   * @param command The command that yielded
049   * @param timestampNanos When the command yielded
050   */
051  record Yielded(Command command, long timestampNanos) implements SchedulerEvent {}
052
053  /**
054   * An event marking when a command completed naturally.
055   *
056   * @param command The command that completed
057   * @param timestampNanos When the command completed
058   */
059  record Completed(Command command, long timestampNanos) implements SchedulerEvent {}
060
061  /**
062   * An event marking when a command threw or encountered an unhanded exception.
063   *
064   * @param command The command that encountered the error
065   * @param error The unhandled error
066   * @param timestampNanos When the error occurred
067   */
068  record CompletedWithError(Command command, Throwable error, long timestampNanos)
069      implements SchedulerEvent {}
070
071  /**
072   * An event marking when a command was canceled. If the command was canceled because it was
073   * interrupted by another command, an {@link Interrupted} will be emitted immediately prior to the
074   * cancellation event.
075   *
076   * @param command The command that was canceled
077   * @param timestampNanos When the command was canceled
078   */
079  record Canceled(Command command, long timestampNanos) implements SchedulerEvent {}
080
081  /**
082   * An event marking when a command was interrupted by another. Typically followed by an {@link
083   * Canceled} event.
084   *
085   * @param command The command that was interrupted
086   * @param interrupter The interrupting command
087   * @param timestampNanos When the command was interrupted
088   */
089  record Interrupted(Command command, Command interrupter, long timestampNanos)
090      implements SchedulerEvent {}
091
092  /**
093   * An event marking when a child command could not be forked.
094   *
095   * @param command The command attempting to fork the child commands
096   * @param failures The reasons the child commands could not be forked
097   * @param timestampNanos When the child commands were attempted to be forked
098   */
099  record ForkFailure(Command command, List<ScheduleResult.Failure> failures, long timestampNanos)
100      implements SchedulerEvent {}
101}
